name: exam-studio
description: Exam Studio integration for Claude: generate exams, study notes, handouts, and flashcards from course notes via the remote MCP server.
author: Exam Studio

slash_commands.name: /exam
slash_commands.description: Generate an exam paper from course notes with a separate marking scheme.

arguments.name: notes
arguments.description: Course notes text or file path

slash_commands.name: /notes
slash_commands.description: Generate structured study notes from course notes.

arguments.name: notes
arguments.description: Course notes text or file path

slash_commands.name: /handout
slash_commands.description: Generate a printable study handout: one lesson per indicative content, with worked examples, diagrams, revision, and study tips.

arguments.name: notes
arguments.description: Course notes text or file path

slash_commands.name: /flashcards
slash_commands.description: Generate flashcards including trap cards for commonly confused terms.

arguments.name: notes
arguments.description: Course notes text or file path

slash_commands.name: /usage
slash_commands.description: Check your daily generation quota and remaining allowance.
